concerns: The use of EAGER fetching on Proxy in TGAccount might cause performance issues if loading many accounts; consider using LAZY fetching.
The status field in TGAccount is a plain String; using an Enum would improve type safety and validation.
The ADR specifies Python Pyrogram over gRPC/REST. Clearly defining the API contract early will prevent potential integration friction.
The status fields in both Campaign and Lead are mapped as plain String; using a JPA AttributeConverter or Enum would be safer.
Instant.now() default values in entities might lead to slight mismatch between database-generated timestamps and entity-level timestamps if not handled carefully.
Using UUID strings as primary keys (VARCHAR(36)) can degrade query and insert performance at scale compared to UUID or BIGINT types.
Status and sender_type fields are represented as raw Strings, which could benefit from Enums for validation.

The undo migration file U20260726003554409__crm_query_optimization_schema.sql drops several tables. Since these tables are also defined or may be defined in other PRs (like messages, leads, telegram_accounts), running this undo script could accidentally delete tables and cause data loss.
The database schema has double precision for scores, but in Java, it is mapped to Double. Ensure no floating-point precision issues arise during comparisons.
